summary: Today presents a mixed legal and market environment for retail legal counsel. Key drivers include CAIT's ₹1 lakh crore Dhanteras trade forecast, Delhi High Court vehicle exemptions, and regulatory signals on digital platform liability.

bullets.text: The Delhi High Court exempted NCR lawyers and court staff from the regional ban on non-BS VI vehicles.
E-commerce's share in India's FMCG retail sales tripled over the last two years, according to Nielsen data.
CAIT projects Dhanteras sales across India to top ₹1 lakh crore, including ₹60,000 crore in gold and silver.
Reliance launched ₹5 Independence biscuit packs, though Britannia's CEO stated disrupting the market will be difficult.
IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw urged social media platforms to curb online harms, withholding clarity on safe-harbour immunity.
